newsitem.title: USA: VideoLan Technologies says suit meritless.
newsitem.headline: VideoLan Technologies says suit meritless.

text.p: VideoLan Technologies Inc said it believes a second class-action lawsuit filed against the company is repetitive and meritless.
The second suit has been filed by the law firm of Abbey, Gardy & Squitieri LLP.

In May, lawyers for investors who bought VideoLan securities over a seven-month period filed a lawsuit accusing the company of making false and misleading statements to the effect it had entered into an agreement with Samsung Co of South Korea.
That complaint alleged that VideoLan misrepresented the Samsung agreement and artificially inflated the price of its securities during that period.
VideoLan has not responded directly to the allegations in the lawsuits but said the second mirrored the first.
In a statement, the company said it "believes that both suits are without merit and it intends to vigorously defend itself against the suits."
VideoLan develops video conferencing and video broadcast solutions.
